definitions.full: H666. apher אֲפֵר noun [masculine] covering, bandage (Assyrian ipru , covering Zim BP 95 , êpartu , garment , Id. ib. & Dl Pr 54 ) ׳א עַלעֵֿינָיו 1Kin 20:38 compare 20:41 . אֶפְרֹחַ see פרח .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 665 (in the sense of covering);
